description: This file defines the EntityCondition interface used for constructing and handling SQL 'WHERE' clause conditions within the OFBiz framework. It includes static factory methods for creating various condition expressions, methods for SQL string generation, validation, and matching logic.

classes.name: EntityCondition
classes.description: Interface representing SQL condition expressions for entity queries, with methods for building, validating, and rendering conditions.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Factory methods for creating various types of EntityCondition instances, including comparisons, conjunctions, and raw SQL conditions.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to process this condition.

methods.name: makeWhereString
methods.description: Generates the SQL 'WHERE' clause string for this condition.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Validates the condition against the entity model.

methods.name: entityMatches
methods.description: Checks if the condition matches a given entity.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Checks if the condition matches a map of entity fields.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns a frozen (immutable) version of this condition.
